description: Index of all relevant features, classes, entities, components, and contracts defined in the GPWCF Primary Architecture Prefect Integration domain documents. Links are relative to this index file location.

records.name: Prefect Integration Binding (Wave 5 Artifact 1)
records.description: Wave 5 detailed design (artifact 1) defining the Prefect 3.9.2 integration boundary that binds GPWCF's runtime-independent Stage, Step, SPU, and selected Supporting Pattern contracts to Prefect-native Flows, Deployments, Subflows, and Tasks while preserving domain ownership, identities, results, and operational evidence.

records.name: Prefect Integration Package
records.description: The integration package's responsibility, ownership, and dependency boundary; owns Prefect integration concerns separate from Core, with Prefect as opt-in dependency never a Core dependency.

records.name: Integration Boundary / Responsibility
records.description: Defines the boundary that binds GPWCF domain contracts to Prefect-native execution constructs while preserving domain ownership, identities, results, and operational evidence as distinct from Prefect operational records.

records.name: Prefect 3.9.2 Runtime Decision
records.description: Accepted governing decision: Prefect 3.9.2 is the initial pinned external workflow runtime; decision record ADR-GPWCF-PREFECT-001; no reconsideration of Prefect adoption in this artifact.

records.name: Stage Flow/Deployment Binding
records.description: Native Prefect realization of Stage execution as Stage Flow/Deployment using the accepted run_deployment(..., as_subflow=True) profile from PHASE-02 topology qualification.

records.name: run_deployment(as_subflow=True) Profile
records.description: Accepted Stage invocation mechanism from PHASE-02: Root-owned Prefect dispatch Task calls run_deployment(..., as_subflow=True), creating a deployment Flow Run with synthetic parent linkage and explicit Stage result persistence.

records.name: Step Subflow Binding
records.description: Native Prefect realization of Step execution as a Step Subflow; Stage-to-Step dispatch through a Prefect Task invoking a native Step Subflow while preserving the public Step callable boundary and native child Flow Run.

records.name: SPU Task Binding
records.description: Native Prefect realization of SPU execution as a Prefect Task inside the owning Step Subflow; SPU Tasks submit to the Step Flow's ThreadPoolTaskRunner and join their futures; SPUExecutionResult remains distinct from StepExecutionResult.

records.name: Supporting Pattern Task Binding
records.description: Native Prefect realization of selected Supporting Pattern (Validation, Error Handling, Observation) execution as Prefect Tasks, preserving each pattern's specialized behavior, result, identity, association, lifecycle, and custody contract.

records.name: Invocation Translation
records.description: Translation of GPWCF domain invocations to native Prefect Flow/Task run invocations while preserving domain identity, invocation acceptance, and result semantics; dispatch Tasks carry no GPWCF business or composition semantics.

records.name: Domain/Native Identity Correlation
records.description: Correlation between GPWCF domain identities (Pipeline, Stage, Step, SPU, invocation) and Prefect native identities (Flow Run IDs, Task Run IDs, Deployment IDs); neither namespace substitutes for the other.

records.name: Typed Result Preservation
records.description: Preservation of typed domain results (SPUExecutionResult, StepExecutionResult, StageResult) through Prefect execution without replacing them with Prefect operational State; Prefect State is operational execution evidence, not a domain result.

records.name: Stage Result Persistence/Retrieval
records.description: Stage result persistence/retrieval obligations using persist_result=True; Root waits for Deployment Flow Run terminal state and loads persisted Stage domain result through Prefect result reference; multi-host storage remains unqualified.

records.name: Integration Public API Boundary
records.description: Configuration ownership and integration Public API boundary; Core must remain usable with Prefect absent; no Prefect types leak into Core API; Public API is an explicit curated stable boundary under public_api.

records.name: Configuration Ownership
records.description: Configuration ownership for the integration package; defines how integration configuration is held and applied without creating a universal scheduler, dispatcher, worker manager, deployment manager, or runtime registry.

records.name: PHASE-01/02 Qualification Limits
records.description: The exact PHASE-01/02 evidence and qualification limits: native hierarchy qualification, same-host two-worker deployment qualification, nondeterministic Stage sibling overlap, serialized Step sibling subflows, SPU Task fan-out/fan-in evidence; production GPWCF binding remains unqualified.

records.name: Excluded Concerns (Non-Goals)
records.description: Excludes: GPWCF Pipeline Root Entity/Aggregate, universal workflow adapter/plugin manager/runtime registry/scheduler/dispatcher/worker manager/deployment manager, generic business workflow definition, universal serializer/result codec registry/Publisher service/event bus/recovery manager, unqualified failure/cancellation/timeout/retry/worker-loss/recovery/multi-host/high-scale behavior.

records.name: Operational Mapping (Wave 5 Artifact 2)
records.description: Wave 5 detailed design (artifact 2) defining the operational mapping between GPWCF domain invocations/results/identities/lifecycle/custody and Prefect-native execution records/identities/States, explicitly preventing operational status from being mistaken for domain outcome or safe settlement.

records.name: Domain vs Prefect Operational Identity Namespaces
records.description: Separation of domain and Prefect operational identity namespaces: domainNamespace (PipelineInvocationIdentity, StageIdentity, StepIdentity, SPUIdentity, ...) vs prefactNamespace (PipelineFlowRunId, StageFlowRunId, StepFlowRunId, SPUTaskRunId, ...); neither namespace substitutes for the other.

records.name: Domain-to-Native Invocation Mapping
records.description: Mapping of Stage, Step, SPU, and Supporting Pattern invocations to native Flow/Task runs; defines how each GPWCF invocation boundary corresponds to a Prefect-native execution construct while preserving parent/child correlation.

records.name: Domain Result vs Prefect State Interpretation
records.description: Distinction between domain result and Prefect State interpretation: no Prefect State value by itself proves a GPWCF domain success/failure/cancellation settlement/result acceptance/publication acceptance/safe release; no GPWCF domain result proves Prefect persisted/retrieved/operationally completed every native execution record.

records.name: Parent/Child Correlation
records.description: Parent/child correlation between Pipeline Root Flow Run, Stage Flow Run, Step Subflow Flow Run, and SPU Task Run; synthetic deployment/subflow invocation records create indirect parent linkage chains preserved through native Prefect task_inputs.__parents__ and parent_task_run_id.

records.name: Synthetic Deployment/Subflow Invocation Records
records.description: Prefect-generated synthetic Task Runs that link deployment/subflow invocations to parent dispatch Task Runs; Stage Flow Run.parent_task_run_id points to the synthetic Task Run, not directly to the user-defined Root dispatch Task Run; task_inputs.__parents__ contains the Root dispatch Task Run ID.

records.name: Result Persistence/Retrieval Mapping
records.description: Mapping of result persistence/retrieval across the integration boundary; persisted Stage domain results retrieved separately from Prefect State; serialization/persistence failures remain operational failures and do not fabricate domain results.

records.name: Serialization Failure Semantics
records.description: Serialization failure semantics for result persistence/retrieval: failures are operational failures, not domain outcomes; no universal serializer, codec registry, or artifact storage service is introduced.

records.name: Cancellation/Timeout/Recovery Mapping Constraints
records.description: Mapping constraints for cancellation, timeout, retry, worker loss, recovery, and lifecycle: no universal retry/cancellation/timeout/compensation/recovery policy; unqualified failure/cancellation/timeout/retry/worker-loss/recovery behavior remains open.

records.name: Operational Evidence Retention
records.description: Operational evidence retention and reporting responsibilities; concurrency evidence is exact and not generalized beyond the qualified two-worker profile; all open operational questions remain visible and are not described as qualified.

records.name: Governing Rule: No State/Domain Inference
records.description: Governing rule: Prefect State and native identifiers describe how the external runtime executed and recorded a native Flow/Task; GPWCF domain identities, invocation acceptance, results, outcomes, lifecycle, and custody describe what the domain contract accepted, produced, and settled. Neither namespace substitutes for the other (noStateInference and noDomainInference).
